keyed_to.corporate: facility_id / borrower_id of the corporate book
keyed_to.retail: account_id / customer_id of the retail book

dictionary.breach_id: The breach's id: check, entity and a sequence number when one entity breaches a check more than once.
dictionary.check_id: The check's id (CRM-<article paragraph>), e.g. CRM-9.23.
dictionary.article: The paragraph of the CBUAE Credit Risk Management Standards the check tests, e.g. CBUAE CRM Art. 9.23.
dictionary.title: The check in a few words.
dictionary.rule: The rule of the Standards the check tests, in one sentence.
dictionary.book: The book checked: corporate (quarterly) or retail (monthly).
dictionary.period: The book's period checked: a quarter (corporate, 2026Q2) or a month (retail, 2026-08).
dictionary.entity_type: What breaches: a facility (corporate), an account (retail) or the book (a book-level rule).
dictionary.entity_id: The facility (CF…), account (RA…) or book id that breaches.
dictionary.owner_id: The borrower (CB…) or customer (RC…) behind the entity; the book id for a book-level rule.
dictionary.measured: The value measured on the books (as text: a stage, a number of days or months, a percentage, an amount).
dictionary.required: The value the Standards require (as text, in the same unit as measured).
dictionary.unit: The unit of measured and required.

ead_sar_mn.description: Exposure at default of the breaching entity (for a book rule, of the book's Stage 3).

ecl_sar_mn.description: Expected credit loss held on the breaching entity.

shortfall_sar_mn.description: Provision shortfall against the Standards' floor (0 for a non-provision check).

dictionary.detail: What the check found, in one line.
dictionary.level: The level the check works at: facility, account or book.
dictionary.tested: How many entities of the book the check tested (1 for a book-level rule).
dictionary.breaches: How many entities breach the check.
